_readme: Per-key exceptions to i18n:check. Shape: { "<key>": ["<rule>", ...] }. Rules: digits, latin, arabic-in-en, left-right, banned, punctuation, plural, icu-format, length, tanween. Every entry needs a reason in _reasons. Keep this file nearly empty.

_reasons.clientOnboardingLanguageNativeAr: A language tile always shows the language's own name in its own script (an endonym): 'العربية' stays Arabic in the English catalogue so the tile reads the same in both interface languages (CL-ONBD-01).
_reasons.clientOnboardingLanguageNativeEn: The same for English: 'English' stays Latin in the Arabic catalogue (CL-ONBD-01).
